findings.title: Create Staff (Admin) test data is not idempotent
findings.description: The 'Create Staff (Admin)' request body hardcodes the email newserver@demo-bistro.demo. The first live execution of the folder-as-defined returned 400 because that email (and newserver2@demo-bistro.demo) already exist in the tenant from earlier test runs, both left inactive. This makes the request fail on every re-run after the first. Re-running the same request with a unique email (newserver.livetest.<unix_ts>@demo-bistro.demo) succeeded with 201, and the subsequent Deactivate Staff call succeeded with 200 using the returned id, confirming the endpoints themselves work correctly. Recommendation: parametrize the email with a Postman dynamic variable (e.g. {{$timestamp}}) so the request collection is idempotent across runs.
